Name: PickAxe
Author: szzrain
Description:
[center][b][size=6]中文[/size][/b][/center]
[spoiler]此 mod 添加了镐斧。 镐斧是同时有镐子和斧子功能的组合工具。无论是采矿还是砍树，都可以使用同一把工具，减少来回切换的操作。
[b][size=4]主要特色[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]普通、铜、钢、金、铱五种等级，配有对应的图标和挥动贴图。[/*]
[*]根据使用目标自动执行镐子或斧子的功能，能力与同等级原版工具一致。[/*]
[*]最多同时拥有两个不同的附魔，分别来自镐子和斧子的附魔。[/*]
[*]支持在原版火山锻造台合成和拆解。[/*]
[/list][b][size=4]如何合成[/size][/b]
在火山锻造台的左侧放入镐子，右侧放入斧子。两件工具必须为相同等级，消耗 [b]20 个火山晶石[/b]，即可合成同等级镐斧。
合成会分别继承两件原料的第一个附魔。如果两者同名，则只保留镐子的附魔。
[b][size=4]双附魔机制[/size][/b]
镐斧拥有一个镐子附魔槽和一个斧子附魔槽，两个槽不能持有同名附魔。附魔时优先填补空槽；两个槽都已有附魔时，随机替换其中一个，保留另一个。
槽位用于记录附魔来源，附魔效果共同作用于整把工具。例如，强力与省力的组合可以同时改善挖矿和砍树体验。独有附魔仍遵循原版的适用目标。
[b][size=4]如何拆解[/size][/b]
将镐斧放在锻造台左侧，右侧留空，点击取消锻造按钮，即可取回同等级的镐子、斧子以及 [b]10 个火山晶石[/b]。
当前附魔会按照所属槽位分别返还给对应工具，包括合成后重新获得的附魔。拆解前需要至少两个空背包格。
[b][size=4]安装要求[/size][/b]
SMAPI 4.0 或更新版本，以及 Content Patcher 2.0 或更新版本。请将压缩包中的 PickAxe 文件夹解压到你游戏的 Mods 文件夹中[/spoiler]

[center][b][size=6]English[/size][/b][/center]
[left][spoiler]PickAxe adds a combined tool to Stardew Valley with the abilities of a pickaxe and an axe of the same tier. Break rocks, mine ore, and chop trees without switching between two tools.
[b][size=4]Features[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]Five tiers: Basic, Copper, Steel, Gold, and Iridium, each with matching inventory and tool sprites.[/*]
[*]Automatically uses pickaxe or axe behavior depending on the target.[/*]
[*]Matches the capabilities of vanilla tools of the same tier.[/*]
[*]Supports two different enchantments, one from each tool’s enchantment pool.[/*]
[*]Can be combined and separated at the vanilla Volcano Forge.[/*]
[/list][b][size=4]Combining Your Tools[/size][/b]
Place a pickaxe in the left slot and an axe in the right slot at the Volcano Forge. Both tools must be the same tier. Combining them costs [b]20 Cinder Shards[/b] and produces a PickAxe of that tier.
The PickAxe inherits the first enchantment from each ingredient. If both enchantments are the same, only the pickaxe’s enchantment is retained.

[b][size=4]Double Enchantments[/size][/b]
The PickAxe has one pickaxe enchantment slot and one axe enchantment slot. The two slots cannot hold the same enchantment.
Enchanting fills an empty slot first. Once both slots are occupied, enchanting randomly replaces one while preserving the other.
Slots track where enchantments come from; their effects apply across the combined tool wherever applicable. For example, Powerful and Efficient benefit both mining and chopping. Each enchantment still follows its vanilla target restrictions.

[b][size=4]Separating Your Tools[/size][/b]
Place the PickAxe in the left slot, leave the right slot empty, and click the Unforge button. You will receive a pickaxe and an axe of the same tier, along with [b]10 Cinder Shards[/b].
Current enchantments are restored to their corresponding tools, including enchantments obtained after combining. At least two empty inventory slots are required.

[b][size=4]Requirements and Installation[/size][/b]
Requires Stardew Valley 1.6, SMAPI 4.0 or later, and Content Patcher 2.0 or later.
Extract the Pickaxe folder into your game's Mods folder.[/spoiler]
[/left]
